paragraphs.en: If something that you're doing doesn't challenge you, then it doesn't change you.Spoiled by modern {civilization} , we easily {settle} into our daily routines.Yet we all need some {normal} stress in our lives, as the most rewarding experiences often lie beyond the familiar, waiting for {pioneers} to explore them.Think of comfort zones as a {cozy} {blanket} that keeps us warm but also {restricts} our {motions} .You can never see any improvement if you stick to it.The {willingness} to face {trials} is what successful people share as a common trait, whether they are a respected {gentleman} or {lady} , or a {badminton} {champion} .Challenge the {following} {limits} .It's essential to recognize that personal growth occurs when we dare to step into the {distant} unknown.
paragraphs.cn: 如果你所做的事情对你来说没有挑战性，那么它就无法改变你。我们被现代 <u> 文明 </u> 宠坏了，很容易 <u> 安于 </u> 日常惯例。然而，我们在生活中都需要一些 <u> 正常的 </u> 压力，因为最有价值的经历常常存在于熟悉的事物之外，等待着 <u> 先驱 </u> 们去探索。可以把舒适区想象成一条 <u> 舒服的毯子 </u> ，它让我们感到温暖，但也 <u> 限制 </u> 了我们的 <u> 行动 </u> 。如果你一直待在舒适区，你就永远看不到进步。 <u> 愿意 </u> 面对 <u> 考验 </u> 是成功人士的共同特点，无论他们是受人尊敬的 <u> 绅士 </u> 或 <u> 淑女 </u> ，还是 <u> 羽毛球冠 </u> <u> 军 </u> 。挑战 <u> 以下 </u> 这些 <u> 极限 </u> 吧。必须认识到，当我们敢于踏入 <u> 遥远的 </u> 未知领域时，个人成长才会发生。

paragraphs.en: Figure out what you're scared of and do it {continuously} .
paragraphs.cn: 找出你害怕的事，并 <u> 不断 </u> 去做。

paragraphs.en: Many people feel {dizzy} at the thought of change, and that's perfectly natural.This temporary discomfort is a small {price} to pay for the {treasure} waiting on the other side.If you're a {salesman} , and you're scared of talking to people {personally} or over the {phone} now, instead of being {frightened} and thinking you'll fail, spend at least five minutes a day picking up the phone and make a call.Someone may hang up on you, but don't get too {disappointed} ! Eventually, you can look fear in the eye and say,”Go on.I'm not scared!”
paragraphs.cn: 很多人一想到改变就 <u> 头晕目眩 </u> ，这很正常。这种暂时的不适，与改变之后等待我们的 <u> 财富 </u> 相比，只是一个很小的 <u> 代价 </u> 。假设你是一名 <u> 推销员 </u> ，你现在害怕 <u> 当面 </u> 与人交谈或打 <u> 电话 </u> 。与其 <u> 害怕 </u> 并认为自己会失败，不如每天至少花五分钟拿起电话拨打出去。也许有些人会挂断你的电话，但不要因此太过 <u> 失望 </u> ！最终，你会直面恐惧，并说：“继续做吧，我不怕！”

paragraphs.en: Take a class for a hobby you've been wanting to develop.
paragraphs.cn: 为你一直想培养的爱好报个（兴趣）班。

paragraphs.en: The journey out of one's comfort zone doesn't require a {grand} gesture like climbing a {tower} or becoming an {astronomer} .Make sure this hobby is not linked to your {career} ; it should help you relax and {relieve} stress.Some examples might be learning a new language like {German} or {Russian} , trying to play the {guitar} and so on. {Apart} from helping you challenge yourself, taking a class for your hobby may also give you extra {income} .
paragraphs.cn: 走出舒适区并不需要像攀登 <u> 塔楼 </u> 或成为 <u> 天文学家 </u> 那样 <u> 宏伟的 </u> 举动。确保这个爱好与你的 <u> 职业 </u> 无关；它应当有助于你放松身心、 <u> 缓解 </u> 压力。举几个例子，你可以学习一门新语言，如 <u> 德语 </u> 或 <u> 俄语 </u> ，也可以尝试弹 <u> 吉他 </u> 等等。 <u> 除了 </u> 帮助你挑战自我之外，为爱好报一门课程可能还会为你带来额外的 <u> 收入 </u> 。

paragraphs.en: Set {aside} at least {nine} minutes a day for physical exercise.
paragraphs.cn: 每天至少 <u> 留出九 </u> 分钟进行体育锻炼。

paragraphs.en: You don't need to go to the {gym} .A simple nine-minute run around your neighborhood can do wonders for you.Exercise can not only help you maintain your {regular} weight, but also make you feel {better} about yourself.
paragraphs.cn: 你不需要去 <u> 健身房 </u> 。在你家附近简单地跑九分钟就能给你带来意想不到的效果。运动不仅能帮你保持 <u> 正常 </u> 体重，还能让你对自己感觉 <u> 更好 </u> 。

paragraphs.en: Travel and open yourself up to meeting new people.
paragraphs.cn: 去旅行，让自己有机会结识新朋友。

paragraphs.en: Don't just limit yourself to your fellow {travelers} , and try to {connect} with the {service} {staff} .You never know what kind of people they're going to be.Book a {ticket} and take a {flight} to an unfamiliar destination right now.
paragraphs.cn: 不要只局限于和同行的 <u> 旅伴 </u> 交流，试着和 <u> 服务人员建立联系 </u> 。你永远不知道他们会是怎样的人。现在就订张机 <u> 票 </u> ， <u> 飞 </u> 往一个陌生的目的地吧。 5NoOncib/NjiX02BpMIzP+Fxyt/ox+WDCb+dhfH7KaYaJ4u5RsVmLondVmcHiLum9J1BQErGzJvzqa5GEIz4ZA==
